en.action.preview: Open the instruction file for {name} in the side panel
en.action.reload.label: Reload
en.action.reloadHint: Reload this server’s plugin instance (equivalent to one hot reload): it disconnects and reconnects. For a stdio service this restarts its child process.
en.card.name: Name
en.footer.feedbackHint: Open the capability panel’s issues on GitHub
en.preset.broken: This preset cannot compose a session: {reason}. Fix it before its tools can be listed.
en.preset.intro: Choose the default capabilities each agent preset starts from; sessions created or resumed afterward inherit it. The composer's Session context changes only the current session, and stays with it across restarts.
en.preset.readonly: Settings storage is read-only. You can inspect tools, but changes cannot be saved.
en.preset.reserved: {name} is a reserved transport and cannot be disabled.
en.preset.title: Capability Panel
en.server.unavailableHint: This host declares the server, but it currently registers no tools. The panel cannot tell why (service not started, mid-reconnect, or genuinely tool-less are all possible). If it is a local on-demand service, start its program first.
en.status.error: Failed to load: {error} (try refreshing the page; host changes take effect after a dsh restart)
